title: Dirichlet nonvanishing at 0.87341198 with a selected-norm leaf
description: Dirichlet nonvanishing for Re(s) > 43670599/50000000 = 0.87341198, principal pole excluded. A new estimate (R1) bounds the energy of rows with a heavy prime-slot block, for cuts K between 0.500001 and 3/4: the rows are split into sixth-root classes, and each class is bounded by Joseph Bebel's selected sextic norm and by the baseline's reflected radial engine. This lets the leaf of Sil's cube-free native step use K = 501/1000 instead of 3/4, so the line of native faces continues from the fourth-power face G(99999/100000, 93/25, 3/50) down to G(99999/100000, 401/200, 13399/100000). The faces are proved by induction along the line, without a list of steps or a density chain. arvi-density's return is retuned to the end face (three windows). The modules of joint-detector-fine-chain that the selected norm needs, and the part of arvi-density's return that reads its constants, are copied into this package. Builds on OpenAI, Hailey Collet, Sil, Jacob Sussman, Joseph Bebel and our earlier work; inherited notices and licenses are retained. The research and Lean development were AI-assisted.
